entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes! I want to return this piece of junk you sent me, now!
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I'm sorry to hear you're having an issue. I can definitely help you with that. Can I start with your order number?
Yeah, it's VF-8675309. And you better help me, or I'm putting this all over social media. This is the worst service I've ever had. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, and I assure you I'm empowered to resolve this for you. I've pulled up your order for the Pro-Series jersey. To make sure I get this right, what specifically is the issue with it?
The issue is it's the wrong size! It's ridiculously too tight. I can barely get it over my shoulders. Are you guys selling children's clothing now? This is a complete joke.

I see. I'm very sorry the fit wasn't what you expected. Let me just check our policy for you... Okay, I can see your order was delivered 20 days ago. Since the jersey is a standard item, it's fully covered under our 90-day return policy.
So? What does that mean? Are you going to fix this or just quote policy at me?
It means we can absolutely get this sorted out. I can process a free exchange for the next size up, or I can issue a full refund to your original payment method. Whichever you prefer.
Oh. You'll just... take it back? Seriously? Fine. I'll do an exchange for the larger size then. How does that work?

Of course. It's a simple process. I've just initiated the exchange in the system, and I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and we'll ship the new one out as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier.
Okay. That's actually... fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help you get the right gear. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
